# `operations.NotificationDue`

A customer notification of template `template_ref` is due for an instance, with the structural data to render it ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md)). Engine-OWNED, engine-cross-cutting event under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) — the engine owns this schema and the `trigger_kind` taxonomy ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) §6). The engine emits only EVENT_DRIVEN + PRE_CONTRACTUAL; the enum RETAINS SCHEDULED for a DOWNSTREAM producer — the family-agnostic notification scheduler ([ADR-IC-019](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-019-family-agnostic-notification-platform.md)) reads the maturity-calendar / accrual projections and produces NotificationDue(SCHEDULED) itself, because the engine emits no clock-driven signal and runs no scheduler ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); the CloudEvents envelope (event_id, partition_key, valid_time/transaction_time, correlation_id) rides in Kafka HEADERS, NOT here. NO PII — cleartext OR ciphertext ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): customer_id is an opaque recipient REFERENCE the communications system resolves at render time against the engine's PII-resolve surface (returning null for a crypto-shredded subject); `data` carries STRUCTURAL interpolation values only (amounts, dates, rates, TAE), never the subject's name, NIF, or contact data.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `notification_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | The idempotency key (slot 4) — a composite of instance_id + template_ref + the triggering occurrence (causation_id for EVENT_DRIVEN; the schedule-occurrence for SCHEDULED), STABLE across outbox redelivery AND event-store replay, so a rebuild never re-notifies. Dedupe runs consumer-side (the communications system owns 'already delivered this one'). Structural, not PII. |
| `instance_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | InstanceId (Guid) — the instance (stream) this notification is about (e.g. a DepositId). partition_key = instance_id (per-instance order, slot 3). Structural reference, not PII. |
| `customer_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | The recipient REFERENCE ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) Decision 1) — an opaque subject id the communications system resolves at render time for BOTH the delivery address and any template-body PII, via the engine-owned PII-resolve surface ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2; returns null for a crypto-shredded subject). NEVER the name/NIF/contact itself: no PII, cleartext or ciphertext, rides this event. |
| `template_ref` | `string` | The pack-namespaced template to render (e.g. pt.disclosure.fin, pt.notice.maturity). The pack owns the template and this namespace ([ADR-PC-007](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-007-signed-yaml-oci-pack.md)). Structural, not PII. |
| `template_pack_version` | `string` | The pack version PINNED on the instance ([ADR-PC-007](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-007-signed-yaml-oci-pack.md) / [ADR-PC-009](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-009-per-instance-version-pinning.md)) — a deposit constituted under pt.2026.1 keeps disclosing under that pack's templates even after a newer pack ships. Structural, not PII. |
| `trigger_kind` | `enum` | The trigger taxonomy ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) §6) — EVENT_DRIVEN \| SCHEDULED \| PRE_CONTRACTUAL. SCHEDULED is downstream-produced only ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). |
| `causation_id` | `null` \| `string` (`uuid`) | The id of the causing domain event for EVENT_DRIVEN (every engine-emitted notification traces to a fact, [ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). NULL for SCHEDULED — a downstream-produced temporal notification has no causing domain event (its occurrence is a date arriving, derived off a projection). Structural reference, not PII. |
| `data` | `map` | STRUCTURAL interpolation values only — amounts, dates, rates, TAE — keyed by template field name ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) Decision 1). NO PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): the renderer resolves the subject's name/NIF/contact at render time by customer_id reference, never from this bag. A self-describing string→string map keeps the contract template-agnostic; the no-PII obligation is on the producer. |
| `due_at` | `int` (`date`) | DueAt (DateOnly) as days since epoch = valid_time ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) Decision 1) — the date the notification is due. Structural, not PII. |
